children: Siemens said it signed a long-term framework agreement valued at around 215 million euros ($244.8 million) with Belgium's national railway infrastructure manager Infrabel.

The deal expands an existing partnership between the German industrial group's mobility division and Infrabel to modernize and maintain the country's operational control system environment, Siemens said Thursday.
The framework agreement will last for 11 years, it added.
